baseDn.description: root location for ldap server ex: "dc=example,dc=com"

userDn.description: location for users in ldap server ex: "ou=people,dc=example,dc=com"

groupDn.description: location for groups in ldap server ex: "ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com"

groupObjectClass.description: ldap server's group type of object class ex: groupOfUniqueNames, groupOfNames, group

peopleObjectClass.description: ldap server's people type of object class as defined inside the groups ex: uniqueMember, member

passwordKey.description: password string in ldap server ex: password, userPassword, passcode

userPrefix.description: prefix for user information Ex: UID, MAIL, S_AMA_ACCOUNT_NAME

groupPrefix.description: prefix for group information Ex: MEMBER, S_AMA_ACCOUNT_NAME
